# Three.js runtime

Unmodified Three.js 0.160.0, vendored so the school-approved game path has no external engine dependency.

- Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r160
- Download: https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js
- SHA-256: `76dea8151bc9352aef3528b4262e249b2604f62543828328db978d060d61a495`
- License: `THREE-LICENSE.txt` (MIT, original upstream text)

Keep the module unmodified. An intentional version update must update its license/provenance and pass gameplay and school-path checks.
